crossRefs.note: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the…

translations.web: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
translations.bsb: He himself was not the Light, but he came to testify about the Light.
translations.kjv: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
translations.asv: He was not the light, but came that he might bear witness of the light.
